facts: Npz contains/size/array share the same member match rule (exact name or optional .npy suffix) and private immutable archive, so current metadata and decode selection agree. Distinct archive members with normalized aliasing require archive admission comparison before collision promotion; suffix removal alone is an intentional external-format adapter.

GarmentPose place is explicitly against original base positions and original immutable-build Pivots; per-panel then whole rigid moves preserve intra-panel rest lengths. Historical base/rest versus current placement are meaningful independent states, and no accumulating-edit bug appears in this implementation. Public mismatched Pivots/base or different panel topology need actual paired admission/recipient proof; current silent end clamping is not a proof of valid correspondence.

OuterLayer owns private BVH and inward direction; current public clearance is read at every correction rather than cached in BVH. Host particle projection uses last-uploaded inverse masses and current readback positions/velocities; native write repacks same mass words coherently. Public custom kernel changing masses would need explicit supported authority/recipient contract before declaring historical host-mass accessor wrong. Same default typed density/mass names do not collapse independent physical meanings.
